case: The same required fields in a different order, which must not be refused.
why: The required list is a set of field names and its order means nothing to any validator that reads it. Pairing the adverse case with this one is what distinguishes a check that asks WHETHER `contested_refs` is demanded from a check that pins the exact bytes of a list -- the second kind fails on every unrelated field anyone ever adds to this record, and gets deleted for it.
